description: Knobs for tuning the awesome bar ranking during development. Reload the desk after saving. Clear a field to fall back to its default.

fields.description: Results scoring within this fraction of the best match are treated as near-ties and reordered by your history. 1 reorders nothing, 0.5 reorders half the list — lower it to let history win more often.
fields.label: Near-Tie Band

fields.description: How long a visit keeps half its weight. Shorter favours what you opened this week, longer favours what you open most overall.
fields.label: Visit Half Life (Days)

fields.description: How many of your top routes ride along with boot. Anything outside this list ranks as never visited.
fields.label: Routes Sent At Boot

fields.description: Confidence a remembered pick needs before it is pinned. Below about 0.67 a single pick already pins; raise it to demand a repeated habit.
fields.label: Minimum Confidence

fields.description: How long a remembered pick keeps half its weight once the query goes unused.
fields.label: Memory Half Life (Days)

name: Awesomebar Lab Settings
